reason: Redis not available in current environment; PREP only.

limitations: not shared across multiple gunicorn/uvicorn workers (true single-worker today)
no persistence across blue/green or canary swap
cannot enforce limits across multiple regions / pods

key_design.strategy: sliding window via Redis sorted set; ZADD timestamp_ms, ZREMRANGEBYSCORE older than window, ZCARD count
key_design.atomicity: single Redis pipeline per probe (zadd+zremrangebyscore+zcard+expire). Sufficient for low-impact canary.
key_design.fairness: sliding window is closer to fair than fixed bucket; acceptable for canary.

fallback_behavior.on_redis_init_error: fall back to memory backend permanently for the process lifetime
fallback_behavior.rationale: During internal beta the cost of a denial-of-service from a Redis outage is greater than the cost of a momentary in-memory window
fallback_behavior.future_change_for_broad_rollout: switch to FAIL_CLOSED with retry budget and 503 envelope once Stage5 is approved

rollout_strategy.phase_1_PREP: This task. Adapter skeleton, plan, probe scripts. No live switch.
rollout_strategy.phase_2_DRY_RUN_LOCAL: Install Redis locally, run probe with AFFINITY_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND=redis in a sidecar test, validate equivalence with memory backend.
rollout_strategy.phase_3_GATED_LIVE: Switch supervisor env to redis after: (a) probe PASS, (b) Stage4 24-72h clean, (c) signoff package V6 approval, (d) Redis HA decision.
rollout_strategy.phase_4_BROAD_ROLLOUT_PREREQ: Required before any broad rollout consideration.

rollback_plan.runtime_toggle: set AFFINITY_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND=memory in supervisor.conf, supervisorctl restart backend
rollback_plan.data_cleanup_redis: DEL keys matching af2:ratelimit:* (optional; safe to leave for TTL expiry)
